page_title: VIL 3-1 PAL | Villarreal v Las Palmas 30/09/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+256' Mario Melero Lopez shows a yellow card to Adnan Januzaj (Las Palmas) for his unsportsmanlike behavior after the match has ended.
90+11' That's the end of the match.

90+7' An amazing individual effort from Alex Baena (Villarreal) ends with a strike from inside the penalty area. He sends the ball precisely into the bottom left corner and makes it 3:1. Dinko Horkas was helpless.
90+5' Manuel Fuster (Las Palmas) takes the free kick but it is cleared by the first defender.
90+4' A player from Villarreal brings down an opponent and commits a foul. Las Palmas are awarded a free kick.
90+2' The Las Palmas players are exchanging some short passes.
90' We will have 9 min. of added time.
88' Substitution. Juan Bernat (Villarreal) has come on for Sergi Cardona.
87' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Ramon Terrats (Villarreal) will replace Nicolas Pepe.
86' Luis Carrion decides to make a substitution. Dario Essugo will be replaced by Jaime Mata (Las Palmas).
84' 2 - 1 Thierno Barry (Villarreal) finds some space inside the box and scores with a crashing header into the middle of the net, giving the goalkeeper no chance.
84' Wait! Referee Mario Melero Lopez immediately makes the VAR signal, most likely to see if there was an offside in the build-up play.
84' The assistant referee raises his flag and the referee blows his whistle. Thierno Barry (Villarreal) puts the ball into the net, but he is flagged for offside.
83' One of the players from Las Palmas times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
82' Villarreal are showcasing great team work by exchanging some short passes and one-two passes, waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
80' Nicolas Pepe (Villarreal) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
78' Here comes a substitution. Benito Ramirez is given a rest as he is replaced by Viti (Las Palmas).
77' Here's the change. Adnan Januzaj leaves the pitch and Enzo Loiodice (Las Palmas) comes on as a substitute.
77' Here is a change. Pape Gueye is going off and Marcelino gives the last tactical orders to Santi Comesana (Villarreal).
77' We are about to witness a substitution. Pau Cabanes (Villarreal) is replacing Ilias Akhomach.
76' Gooal! No wait, it's been ruled out for offside. Thierno Barry (Villarreal) disagrees, but the linesman is sure about his call.
75' The ball goes behind for a corner. Villarreal will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
75' Villarreal spell of possession comes to an end after a mistake. Villarreal get a corner.
73' Las Palmas enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.

70' Pape Gueye (Villarreal) is the first to arrive to a rebound inside the penalty area and unleashes a quick strike towards the middle of the target that beats the keeper. One of the defenders, however, makes a goal-line clearance.
68' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Villarreal was in an offside position.
66' Manuel Fuster (Las Palmas) strikes a shot towards goal from the edge of the penalty box, but it flies just wide of the left post.
66' Pape Gueye (Villarreal) commits an ugly challenge. The referee sees it and immediately blows his whistle.
62' Luis Carrion prepares a substitution. Oliver McBurnie is replaced by Manuel Fuster (Las Palmas).
62' A substitution has been made. Kirian Rodriguez is replaced by Javier Munoz (Las Palmas).

62' Kiko Femenia tees up Alex Baena (Villarreal) with a precision cross. He holds off the defender, but fires his shot just over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Las Palmas.
61' Ilias Akhomach (Villarreal) attempts to score with a first-time shot from the edge of the box. His effort towards the middle of the goal is saved by Dinko Horkas.
59' Villarreal keep possession of the ball by producing one-two passes, but an opponent steps in and wins the ball.
56' OFF THE BAR! Adnan Januzaj (Las Palmas) unleashes a thunderous effort from the edge of the box and the ball crashes off the woodwork. What a strike that was!
52' Fabio Silva (Las Palmas) was probably a bit loose with his words to Mario Melero Lopez, who decides to show him a yellow.
51' Dinko Horkas anticipates the direction of the penalty by Alex Baena (Villarreal). He attempted to put the ball inside the left post, but the goalkeeper was there in time to deny him.
51' Alex Baena (Villarreal) is going to take the penalty!
50' The referee shows the yellow card to Dinko Horkas (Las Palmas).
50' Dinko Horkas (Las Palmas) brings an opponent down and Mario Melero Lopez interrupts the game. It's a penalty! Great chance to score for Villarreal!
49' Dani Parejo (Villarreal) makes an unfair challenge by holding his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball.
47' 1 - 1 Goal! Fabio Silva (Las Palmas) gets to the ball inside the box, sees the goalkeeper off his line and lifts the ball over him and into the back of the net. 1:1.
46' Marcelino has made a change at the break. Alex Baena has come on in place of Denis Suarez (Villarreal).
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+3' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45' 3 additional min. will be played.
45' 1 - 0 Goal! Thierno Barry plays a pass to the feet of Nicolas Pepe (Villarreal), and he shoots into the back of the net from inside the box. It's 1:0.
42' Pape Gueye (Villarreal) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
40' Ilias Akhomach (Villarreal) aims for the middle of the goal, but that's an easy job for the goalkeeper. It will take more than that to test him!
40' The resulting set piece from Villarreal is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.

39' Sergi Cardona (Villarreal) has a great chance inside the six-yard box, shoots low to the middle of the goal, but Dinko Horkas pulls off an exquisite save to deny him. The ball goes out of play. Villarreal are awarded a corner kick.
38' A mid-range free kick is awarded to Villarreal out wide and from this angle a cross into the box is likely.
37' Villarreal show off their ball retention skills as they exchange one-two passes and the move is only interrupted when the final pass is intercepted.
34' Thierno Barry (Villarreal) gives away a foul during an attacking move and the referee blows his whistle.
33' The number of shots on goal at present is 0:2.
31' Poor challenge! Sergi Cardona (Villarreal) is penalised for tripping and Mario Melero Lopez blows his whistle.
29' Alex Suarez (Las Palmas) gives the referee no choice but to show him a yellow card.
28' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Las Palmas.
25' Alberto Moleiro (Las Palmas) threads a pass through the eye of a needle into the box for Fabio Silva, but Diego Conde displays great awareness to stop him.
23' Las Palmas have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
22' Fabio Silva (Las Palmas) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Las Palmas.
22' The ball goes out for a corner. Las Palmas can continue in their attacking effort.

21' Oliver McBurnie (Las Palmas) attempts to score as he rises near the penalty spot and heads the ball to the right side of the goal. Diego Conde displays brilliant reflexes and pulls off a comfortable save to stop the ball from hitting the net. Las Palmas force their opponents to concede a corner.
20' Fabio Silva (Las Palmas) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Mario Melero Lopez signals.

17' Ilias Akhomach (Villarreal) finds space inside the box to shoot after collecting a short pass, but it's a wasted effort as it flies well wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Las Palmas will have a goal kick.
16' The Las Palmas players are displaying brilliant short passes and great ball movement. They are waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
13' Villarreal will take a corner kick.
12' Fabio Silva (Las Palmas) spurned a good chance! He gets a shot away from inside the penalty box, but it goes inches wide of the left post.
12' The attendance for today's match is 18159.
10' Las Palmas are happy to keep the ball as they wait for gaps in defence to open up. However, an opposing player steps in and clears.
7' Villarreal are showcasing great team work and neat passing moves.

6' Alex Suarez (Las Palmas) is strong enough to get to the ball and produces a header from close range. Even though it was aimed precisely towards the middle of the goal, Diego Conde didn't have a hard time stopping the attempt as it wasn't powerful enough.
3' Thierno Barry (Villarreal) heads the ball towards goal, but his effort is saved by the goalkeeper.
1' The match has just started.
The players are on the pitch and Villarreal will have the kick-off.
Today's referee will be Mario Melero Lopez.
